## HANDOFF — work is COMPLETE and pushed; only the close remains

**State:** implementation done, committed, pushed. Gerrit change **977**
(https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/977), commit `9bdafc942`, branch
`impl-ac-collapse` in worktree `~/impl-ac-collapse`.

| gate | state |
|---|---|
| `LLM-Review` | **+1** |
| `Verified` (CI) | **pending at handoff** |
| unresolved comments | 0 |

Local full suite `make test` exit 0; `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean.

**To finish this ticket:**
1. Wait for `Verified +1` on 977 (if `-1`, open the run; comment `recheck` if it is a flake).
2. Submit 977. It sits on top of already-merged 969/971, so it should submit alone.
3. `git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main` **in the worktree** (Gerrit rebases
   server-side, so `--ff-only` will refuse; never fast-forward the shared main checkout).
4. `rebar transition 2aa6-726a-ea56-4d6c in_progress closed`.
   **Expect the close gate to demand a fresh `rebar review-plan` first** — I amended AC1 and
   AC3 during implementation (see below), which invalidates the attestation as
   `stale-material`. That is expected, not a defect.
5. Closing this unblocks **93d0** and **44c7** (both depend only on 2aa6 + 35bc, and are
   file-disjoint from each other), then **5f4d** last.

**Two acceptance criteria were amended, with rationale recorded in the description:**
- **AC1** said the whole `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/` tree must return no SC matches, which
  contradicted this story's own Scope and AC6. It now permits exactly the three sites Scope
  deliberately excludes: `plan_review_T2.md` (generic English about a trial's success
  metrics) and the `dod_uncertifiable` wording in both verifier prompts.
- **AC3** said the generated criteria guide's SC grep must be empty. Unsatisfiable: the guide
  is a GENERATED snapshot of the registry and embeds T2's excluded prompt verbatim. Now
  asserts exactly one match — strictly stronger, since it also proves the phrase survived.

**Verified acceptance criteria at handoff:** AC1 (11 in-scope hits gone, only the 3 excluded
remain), AC2 (no bare `SC` in G3), AC3 (guide regenerated, banner intact, exactly one
match), AC4 (grandfathering live — the regver suite passes against this checkout), AC5
(`registry_version` rotation test, both stamps captured at run time), AC6 (T2 keeps its one
match), AC7 (lint/typecheck/suite green).

**TDD:** oracle 10 cases, RED-first; implementer saw only the 2 collapse assertions and never
the 3 anti-overreach guards. Held-out validation 9/10 first pass; the single miss was my own
over-specified AC3 test, not an implementation defect. Mutation: 3/3 killed, including
wrongly renaming T2's excluded phrase.
